acceptance_criteria.description: v1.6.0 planner public surface 收敛为 `beacon-pln-brainstorm`、`beacon-pln-source`、`beacon-pln-review`、`beacon-pln-friction`。
founder/security/performance/doubt/context/simplify/adr/design/deep 等过细 planner 能力进入 `beacon-pln-review` references/reviewer catalog，不作为默认 public route。
`beacon-pln-review/SKILL.md` 是薄入口，详细 reviewer、finding、artifact、state-machine 和 skill-package 规则进入直接引用的 `references/`。
`beacon-pln-review` 遵守 planner HARD GATE，不能写 truth、代码、`.machine/`、QA verdict 或 release verdict。
review artifact 必须保留 `intent_snapshot`，并识别强意图词，防止完整意图被静默弱化。
用户说“完整复刻”“同等能力”“做全”或同类表达时，默认 `scope_mode=full_parity`。
source 项目存在时，必须生成 `source_capability_inventory` 和 `parity_matrix`，否则不能 freeze/implement。
任何 MVP、延期、裁剪或未覆盖能力必须进入 `deferral_ledger` 并要求用户显式接受。
reviewer catalog 必须包含 `state-machine` reviewer，并在 lifecycle/workflow/loop/recovery/permission/source-parity 场景触发。
state-machine reviewer 必须输出 states、transitions、invalid transitions、side effects、recovery paths、terminal states、state axes 和 coverage implications。
package truth 必须支持 `State Model` / `Diagram Truth Layer` 落点；缺失时 route `beacon-gen-truth` 或 `beacon-gen-change`。
package tests 必须覆盖状态转移、非法转移、恢复路径和状态轴组合。
research 中的状态机图/业务流图是 `support_advisory`；只有用户接受并存在 `promotion_ref` 后才能进入 truth/change。
所有 findings 必须包含 reviewer、severity、confidence、authority_level、evidence_refs、affected_truth_surface、recommended_route 和 user_decision_required。
planner findings 默认 `autofix_allowed=false`，不能由 planner 自动改 truth 或实现。
多 reviewer 输出必须 merge/dedup/synthesize 成单一 route recommendation，不能把多个 reviewer 的互斥结论直接丢给用户。
Beacon public skills 必须符合 skill-creator anatomy：frontmatter、精简入口、直接 references、metadata/eval 约束。
`beacon-pln-review` 必须有 skill eval/benchmark cases 覆盖 intent parity、source parity、state-machine、boundary negative 和 finding schema。
本 feature 不改变 Beacon 主生命周期，也不新增 truth/generate/evaluate/release 之外的新主阶段。
materialized/installed v1.6.0 skill package 必须只暴露收敛后的 public planner surface；旧细分 planner 能力只作为 internal reviewer/reference 出现。

test_rows.assertion: v1.6.0 materialized skill package 的 public planner surface 只包含 `beacon-pln-brainstorm`、`beacon-pln-source`、`beacon-pln-review`、`beacon-pln-friction`。

test_rows.command: `python3 -c 'import json, pathlib; text=pathlib.Path("skills/beacon/beacon-pln-review/references/reviewer-catalog.md").read_text(); terms=["founder-business","adversarial-doubt","security-boundary","performance-boundary","context-engineering","simplification-risk","adr-documentation","design-flow","state-machine","not host-visible public skills"]; checks=[{"name": term, "status": "pass"} for term in terms if term in text]; assert len(checks)==len(terms), sorted(set(terms)-set(c["name"] for c in checks)); print(json.dumps({"status":"pass","checks":checks}))'`
test_rows.assertion: founder/security/performance/doubt/context/simplify/adr/design/deep 均作为 internal reviewer 或 references 出现，不作为默认 public planner route。

test_rows.command: `python3 -c 'import json, pathlib; text=pathlib.Path("skills/beacon/beacon-pln-review/SKILL.md").read_text(); refs=["references/reviewer-catalog.md","references/finding-schema.md","references/intent-parity-artifacts.md","references/state-machine-review.md","references/skill-package-standard.md"]; checks=[{"name": ref, "status": "pass"} for ref in refs if ref in text]; assert len(checks)==len(refs), sorted(set(refs)-set(c["name"] for c in checks)); assert len(text.splitlines()) < 120; print(json.dumps({"status":"pass","checks":checks+[{"name":"thin_skill_entry","status":"pass"}]}))'`
test_rows.assertion: `SKILL.md` 是薄入口，并直接引用 reviewer catalog、finding schema、intent parity artifacts、state-machine review 和 skill package standard references。
planner 被要求写 truth、写代码、改 `.machine`、给 QA/release verdict 时，`beacon-pln-review` 被 HARD GATE 阻断并 route。
planner review artifact 保留用户原始强意图词和 `intent_snapshot`。
含“完整复刻/同等能力/做全”的 prompt 默认输出 `scope_mode=full_parity`，不得自动降级 MVP。
source refs 存在但缺少 `source_capability_inventory` 或 `parity_matrix` 时，freeze/implement route 被阻断。
存在 MVP、延期、裁剪或未覆盖能力但缺少 `deferral_ledger` 和 user decision 时，review 输出 P0/P1 finding。

test_rows.command: `python3 -c 'import json, pathlib; text=(pathlib.Path("skills/beacon/beacon-pln-review/references/reviewer-catalog.md").read_text()+"\n"+pathlib.Path("skills/beacon/beacon-pln-review/references/state-machine-review.md").read_text()).lower(); terms=["state-machine","lifecycle","workflow","loop","resume","stop","recovery","permission","source parity"]; checks=[{"name": term, "status": "pass"} for term in terms if term in text]; assert len(checks)==len(terms), sorted(set(terms)-set(c["name"] for c in checks)); print(json.dumps({"status":"pass","checks":checks}))'`
test_rows.assertion: reviewer catalog 包含 `state-machine` reviewer，且触发条件覆盖 lifecycle、workflow、loop、resume/stop/recovery、permission 和 source parity。
state-machine reviewer 输出 states、transitions、invalid transitions、side effects、recovery paths、terminal states、state axes 和 coverage implications。
复杂 feature 需要 state-machine 但 `truth.md` 缺少 `State Model` / `Diagram Truth Layer` 时，review route 指向 `beacon-gen-truth` 或 `beacon-gen-change`。
复杂 feature 需要 state-machine 但 `tests.md` 缺少状态转移、非法转移、恢复路径或状态轴组合覆盖时，review route 指向 `beacon-gen-truth` coverage。
research 状态机图/业务流图被识别为 `support_advisory`，没有 `user_decision` 和 `promotion_ref` 时不能成为 truth closure。

test_rows.command: `python3 -c 'import json, pathlib; text=pathlib.Path("skills/beacon/beacon-pln-review/references/finding-schema.md").read_text(); fields=["reviewer","severity","confidence","authority_level","evidence_refs","affected_truth_surface","recommended_route","user_decision_required"]; checks=[{"name": field, "status": "pass"} for field in fields if field in text]; assert len(checks)==len(fields), sorted(set(fields)-set(c["name"] for c in checks)); print(json.dumps({"status":"pass","checks":checks}))'`
test_rows.assertion: findings 包含 reviewer、severity、confidence、authority_level、evidence_refs、affected_truth_surface、recommended_route 和 user_decision_required。

test_rows.command: `python3 -c 'import json, pathlib; text=pathlib.Path("skills/beacon/beacon-pln-review/references/finding-schema.md").read_text().lower(); checks=[{"name":"autofix_allowed_default_false","status":"pass"},{"name":"planner_routes_instead_of_fixing","status":"pass"}]; assert "autofix_allowed` defaults to `false" in text or "autofix_allowed` defaults to `false`" in text; assert "planner cannot mark qa/release pass" in text; print(json.dumps({"status":"pass","checks":checks}))'`
test_rows.assertion: planner findings 默认 `autofix_allowed=false`，不得声明 planner 可自动改 truth 或实现。
多 reviewer 输出被 merge/dedup/synthesize 为单一 route recommendation，并保留冲突/置信度。

test_rows.command: `python3 -c 'import json, pathlib, yaml; root=pathlib.Path("skills/beacon/beacon-pln-review"); skill=(root/"SKILL.md").read_text(); meta=yaml.safe_load(skill.split("---",2)[1]); checks=[{"name":"frontmatter_name","status":"pass"},{"name":"description_boundary","status":"pass"},{"name":"direct_references","status":"pass"},{"name":"openai_metadata","status":"pass"},{"name":"eval_contract","status":"pass"}]; assert meta["name"]=="beacon-pln-review"; assert "without writing truth, code, QA verdicts, or release verdicts" in meta["description"]; assert "references/skill-package-standard.md" in skill; assert (root/"agents/openai.yaml").exists(); assert "Eval Contract" in (root/"references/skill-package-standard.md").read_text(); print(json.dumps({"status":"pass","checks":checks}))'`
test_rows.assertion: public skills 的 frontmatter、description、references、metadata 和 eval contract 符合 skill-creator anatomy。
eval/benchmark 覆盖 intent parity、source parity、state-machine、boundary negative 和 finding schema。

test_rows.command: `rg "plan -> truth -> generate -> evaluate -> release" docs/beacon/v1.6.0 skills/beacon`

安装/投影到 agent surface 后，只暴露收敛后的 public planner surface；细分 planner 能力只以 internal reviewer/reference 存在。
